headline: On October 29, 2008: Delta Air Lines merges with Northwest
captionCards: Delta now serves 325 destinations in 52 countries
The merger reduced US legacy carriers to just five
instagramCaption:
Delta Air Lines and Northwest Airlines join forces. \\[Delta Air Lines merged with Northwest Airlines on October 29, 2008, creating the world's largest airline at the time. This merger reduced the number of US legacy carriers to five. Delta, headquartered in Atlanta, now operates over 5,400 daily flights to 325 destinations across six continents.
